title: Implement slash goal command
objective: Implement and register /goal using a narrow runtime interface.
context: The slash command should not directly know about session files or the query loop.
The command should make active state visible to the user and preserve permission boundaries.

source_evidence.note: Slash commands implement the Command interface.

include: Add a GoalRuntime interface to commands.Context.
Implement /goal with status, set, edit, pause, resume, clear and aliases.
Return helpful errors when GoalRuntime is missing.

implementation_steps: Add the narrow interface in commands/commands.go.
deliverables: Working /goal slash command in the command registry.
acceptance_criteria: The command does not mutate permissions.
risks: commands.Context can become a catch-all if the interface is too broad.
dispatch_prompt: Implement /goal in commands using the tests from commands/goal_test.go. Add a narrow GoalRuntime interface, register the command, and keep session/loop knowledge out of commands.
notes_for_assignee: Keep missing-runtime behavior explicit so noninteractive tests fail clearly.
